title: Memory: malloc and free
instructions: Sometimes you don't know how much room you need until the program is running. malloc asks the computer for memory on the spot.
malloc(3 * sizeof(int)) asks for enough room for 3 ints and hands back a pointer to it.
When you're done, you MUST give it back with free(pointer). Forgetting to free is called a memory leak.
You use the result just like a normal array: arr[0], arr[1], and so on.
task: Add the free() call at the end so the memory is returned.
hint:
Return the memory you borrowed:

    free(arr);
